messages.content: Tracking shows delivered but I never got the package. I've checked everywhere.
USPS tracking clearly shows it was delivered to your address on the 18th. I have the tracking confirmation.
I understand what tracking shows but I physically don't have the package. My building has secure mailboxes and nothing was there.
Have you checked with your building management? Sometimes carriers leave packages in the office for security.
Yes, I checked with them first. Nothing was logged or held for me.
